meta.name: analyze-project
meta.description: Rigor Analyze / Rigor Audit read-only skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when the user wants to read and understand a repository, inspect model structure and training or inference entrypoints, review configs and insertion points, or flag suspicious implementation patterns without modifying code or running heavy jobs. Do not use for active command execution, broad refactoring, speculative code adaptation, or automatic bug fixing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查深度学习仓库代码结构与实现模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要深入检查深度学习项目的代码质量与潜在问题
copy.tagline_en: Review deep learning repository code structure and implementation patterns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deeply inspect code quality and potential issues in deep learning projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以只读方式分析深度学习研究仓库，输出仓库摘要（SUMMARY.md）、风险提示（RISKS.md）和状态文件（status.json），不会修改代码或运行繁重任务。
howto.when: 当用户想在修改前理解一个深度学习仓库，或需要查看模型结构、训练入口、配置关系，或要求只读分析时触发。

say.text: 请分析这个仓库，告诉我模型结构和训练入口。
say.note: Claude 会生成仓库摘要和结构图。

say.text: 审查这个项目的配置文件，标记可疑的模式。
say.note: Claude 会输出风险提示文件。

say.text: 给我一份仓库的摘要和潜在风险。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude performs a read-only analysis of a deep learning research repository, producing a summary (SUMMARY.md), risk notes (RISKS.md), and a status file (status.json) without modifying code or running heavy tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to understand a deep learning repository before modification, or needs to inspect model structure, training/inference entrypoints, config relationships, or explicitly requests read-only analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this repo and tell me the model structure and training entrypoints.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a summary and structural map.

say_en.text: Review the config files in this project and flag suspicious patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will output a risks file.

say_en.text: Give me a repo summary and potential risks.
say_en.note: Claude will produce both SUMMARY.md and RISKS.md.
